tagline: Helping homeowners and businesses stay connected and in control of their comfort, security, energy use, and smart living
hero_kpi_rationale: The Products and Solutions segment is the strategic core post-spin-off from ADI, with strong exposure to residential automation, energy efficiency, and connected security trends, making it the primary driver of future value.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue increased due to the Snap One acquisition (+$446M), improved pricing strategy, and a more favorable product mix.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by the Snap One acquisition and price increases.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue that remains after paying production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 130 basis points, driven by a better product mix and the Snap One acquisition (+50 bp), despite volume pressure.
kpis.signal: Improvement in product mix quality and Snap One integration.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin increased from 7.7% to 8.1%, supported by revenue growth and cost management, despite higher R&D and SG&A expenses.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement despite high integration costs.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D expenses reached $167M, or 2.2% of revenue (+51% in absolute terms), driven by innovation in connected products and Snap One integration.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in R&D following the Snap One acquisition.

kpis.name: Amortization of Intangible Assets
kpis.explanation: Amortization of acquired or internally developed intangible assets, notably through acquisition integrations.
kpis.description: Amortization of intangible assets reached $122M, primarily due to the Snap One acquisition ($36M) and software development.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase due to software amortization and the Snap One acquisition.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: The company maintains a stable headcount around 149,000 employees, with restructuring costs down 69%.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount despite restructurings and Snap One integration.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.43B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.22B in the latest year

kpis.name: Revenue Contribution from Snap One Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Direct contribution of the Snap One acquisition to total revenue.
kpis.description: The Snap One acquisition generated $446M in revenue in 2025, representing over 60% of the group's total growth.
kpis.signal: Major impact on 2025 growth, accounting for 63% of total growth.

kpis.name: Price and Product Mix Effect
kpis.explanation: Revenue gain from price improvements and a more favorable product mix.
kpis.description: Product mix and pricing strategy added $193M to revenue, reflecting increased valuation of connected solutions and a better portfolio composition.
kpis.signal: Improvement in product portfolio quality and valuation.

risks.title: High Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is discussed in detail in Item 1A and the impact of a 100 bp increase is quantified at $22 million. The language is technical and precise, indicating significant exposure. The removal of the interest rate cap in 2025 increases vulnerability. The Capital category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Unhedged Foreign Exchange Exposure
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly identified in Item 1A, with exposure to multiple currencies. The complete lack of foreign exchange hedging as of December 31, 2025 is emphasized, amplifying the risk. The language indicates active vulnerability. The Macro category is critical in a context of currency volatility.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Item 1A with a detailed list of exposed commodities. The link to geopolitical and tariff factors strengthens its intensity. Pass-through of costs is not guaranteed, creating margin risk. The Industrial category has a medium weighting.

risks.title: Announced Separation from ADI
risks.score_rationale: The announcement of the spin-off of ADI Global Distribution is a major strategic event mentioned in the notes. Separation costs have already been incurred ($18M). The structural change may impact operational and competitive dynamics. The language is forward-looking and substantive.

risks.title: Uncertain Accounting Estimates
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Note 2 as fundamental to several accounting items (impairment, taxes, business combinations). The language indicates that actual results could differ materially. It is a recurring but pervasive risk. The Capital category is relevant.

ai_positioning.summary: The company Rezi does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F report.
